crossRefs.note: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were…

translations.web: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
translations.bsb: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
translations.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
translations.asv: The disciples therefore said one to another, Hath any man brought him aught to eat?
